turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My cat keeps scratching the couch. It's shredded on one side.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Poor couch. Does she have a scratching post?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A little one, she ignores it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then try either a tall sturdy post right by the couch, or a flat cardboard scratcher. Which do you think she'd like?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Give me a minute, my friend just walked in. Don't say anything until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My shoulder still hurts from that class on Tuesday. Did yours?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: A bit. I think it was all those overhead presses.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should I just take a few days off, do you think?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Probably. Or do lower body stuff and leave your arms alone for a while.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, that's probably smarter than skipping completely.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: And put some ice on it tonight.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. Still thinking about how to save that couch?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She stretches up really high, so the tall post.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Perfect. Get one that doesn't wobble and rub a bit of catnip on it to get her interested.
